name: 求职信
scene: Applying for a job, internship, or professional position. More formal than 申请信; includes work experience and skills.
points: Address HR or hiring manager by title. Lead with the role you are applying for. Give 2-3 concrete achievements. Tone: confident, professional, enthusiastic.
structure: State the position you are applying for and how you learned about it.
Highlight relevant experience, skills, and key achievements with specifics.
Express strong interest; request an interview; thank them for their time.

opens.zh: 贵公司近日在……上发布的……职位引起了我的极大兴趣，现冒昧致函申请。
opens.en: I noticed the …… position recently posted by your company on …… and am writing to apply.

opens.zh: 我写信应聘贵公司招聘的……职位，相信我的经历与该职位的要求十分吻合。
opens.en: I am writing to apply for the …… position at your company. I believe my experience is a strong match for the role.

opens.zh: 经……推荐，得知贵公司正在招聘……，特此写信表达我的诚挚意愿。
opens.en: Having been referred by ……, I learnt that your company is recruiting for …… and am delighted to submit my application.

bodies.zh: 我目前就读于……，主修……，成绩优异，曾获……奖学金。
bodies.en: I am currently studying …… at ……, majoring in ……, with excellent results, and have been awarded the …… scholarship.

bodies.zh: 在实习期间，我成功……，为公司带来了……的成效。
bodies.en: During my internship, I successfully ……, bringing …… results for the company.

bodies.zh: 我熟练掌握……，并具备良好的……能力。
bodies.en: I am proficient in …… and possess strong …… skills.

bodies.zh: 我曾主导……项目，带领团队完成了……，积累了宝贵的实战经验。
bodies.en: I led the …… project, guiding the team to complete ……, and gained invaluable hands-on experience.

bodies.zh: 我深信，凭借我在……方面的专业积累，我能够快速融入贵公司的工作节奏并做出贡献。
bodies.en: I firmly believe that with my professional experience in ……, I can quickly adapt to your company's pace and make meaningful contributions.

bodies.zh: 我对贵公司在……领域的卓越成就深感钦佩，渴望成为其中一员。
bodies.en: I greatly admire your company's outstanding achievements in the field of …… and am eager to join the team.

closes.zh: 我非常期待有机会与您当面深谈，详细介绍我的经历与能力。
closes.en: I very much hope to have the opportunity to discuss my experience and abilities with you in person.

closes.zh: 随信附上我的简历，期待您的回复。感谢您百忙之中抽空阅览。
closes.en: Please find my CV enclosed. I look forward to your reply and thank you for your time.

closes.zh: 如能加入贵公司，我将全力以赴，以优异的表现回报您的信任。
closes.en: Should I be given the opportunity to join your company, I will give my all and repay your trust with outstanding performance.

template:
尊敬的___，
  我写信应聘贵公司招聘的___职位。我目前___，主修___，具备___方面的丰富经验。
  在___期间，我___，积累了___方面的能力。此外，我熟练掌握___。
  随信附上我的简历，期待有机会与您当面深谈。感谢您百忙之中抽空阅览。
您的，___

model.zh:
尊敬的人力资源经理，
  贵公司近日在招聘网站上发布的市场助理职位引起了我极大的兴趣，现写信应聘。我相信我的学习背景与实习经历与该职位的要求十分吻合。
  我目前就读于北京大学，主修国际商务，成绩优异。在上学期的实习期间，我在一家跨国企业的市场部工作，成功协助策划了三场线上推广活动，累计触达用户超过十万人次。我熟练掌握数据分析工具及中英文商务写作，并具备良好的团队合作与跨文化沟通能力。
  我对贵公司在行业内的卓越表现深感钦佩，渴望将所学付诸实践。随信附上我的简历，期待有机会与您当面深谈。感谢您百忙之中抽空阅览。
您的，陈雨
model.en:
Dear HR Manager,
  I am writing to apply for the Marketing Assistant position recently posted on your recruitment website. I believe my academic background and internship experience are a strong match for the role.
  I am currently studying International Business at Peking University with excellent results. During my internship last semester, I worked in the marketing department of a multinational company, successfully assisting in the planning of three online promotional campaigns that reached over 100,000 users in total. I am proficient in data analysis tools and business writing in both Chinese and English, and I possess strong teamwork and cross-cultural communication skills.
  I greatly admire your company's outstanding performance in the industry and am eager to apply what I have learned. Please find my CV enclosed. I look forward to the opportunity to speak with you in person. Thank you for your time.
Yours, Chen Yu

name: 自我介绍
scene: Introducing yourself at a job interview, class opening, club activity, or formal meeting.
points: Cover: name → background → strengths → reason for being here → goal. Keep it 1-3 minutes. End with a confident, memorable closing line.
structure: Greet the audience; state your name and current role/status.
Share background, key strengths, and relevant experiences.
State your goal or what you hope to achieve here; express enthusiasm.

opens.zh: 大家好，我叫……，很荣幸有机会在这里做自我介绍。
opens.en: Hello everyone. My name is …… and I am honoured to have this opportunity to introduce myself.

opens.zh: 您好，我是……，目前就读于/就职于……。
opens.en: Hello. I am ……, currently studying at / working at ……

opens.zh: 大家好！我叫……，来自……，很高兴认识大家。
opens.en: Hi everyone! My name is ……, and I come from ……. It's great to meet you all.

bodies.zh: 我的主要专长是……，曾在……积累了丰富的经验。
bodies.en: My main strength is ……; I have built up extensive experience in …… .

bodies.zh: 我性格开朗，善于与人沟通，在团队合作中往往能发挥……的作用。
bodies.en: I am outgoing and good at communicating with others; in teamwork I tend to play the role of ……

bodies.zh: 在过去……年里，我……，这段经历让我……。
bodies.en: Over the past …… years, I have ……. This experience has taught me ……

bodies.zh: 我的兴趣爱好包括……，这些爱好让我……。
bodies.en: My hobbies include ……, which have helped me ……

bodies.zh: 我一直坚信……，这也是我选择……的原因。
bodies.en: I have always believed that ……, which is why I chose ……

closes.zh: 我非常期待在这里与大家共同学习/合作，希望大家多多关照！
closes.en: I am very much looking forward to learning / working with everyone here. I hope for your kind support!

closes.zh: 未来，我希望能在……方面有所建树，也希望能为这个团队贡献自己的一份力量。
closes.en: In the future, I hope to make achievements in …… and contribute to this team in my own way.

closes.zh: 我相信，凭借自己的努力与热情，我一定能在这里做出有意义的贡献。谢谢大家！
closes.en: I believe that with hard work and enthusiasm, I will make meaningful contributions here. Thank you everyone!

template:
大家好，我叫___，来自___，目前___。
  我的主要专长是___，曾在___积累了丰富的经验。我性格___，在团队合作中能发挥___的作用。
  我非常期待在这里与大家___，希望大家多多关照！

model.zh:
大家好，我叫林晓，来自广州，目前是北京大学中文系大三学生。很荣幸有机会在这里做自我介绍。
  我的主要专长是中文写作与对外汉语教学。大一时，我加入了学校的汉语志愿教学团队，至今已为来自十个国家的留学生提供了一对一的中文辅导，积累了丰富的跨文化交流经验。我性格外向，善于倾听，在团队项目中通常担任沟通协调的角色。
  我一直坚信语言是最好的桥梁，这也是我选择这个专业的原因。未来，我希望能在汉语国际推广领域有所贡献，也希望能在这里向大家学习。我的座右铭是：「学而不厌，诲人不倦。」
  非常期待与大家共同成长，请多多关照！
model.en:
Hello everyone. My name is Lin Xiao, I am from Guangzhou, and I am currently a third-year student in the Department of Chinese Language and Literature at Peking University. It is my honour to introduce myself here.
  My main strengths are Chinese writing and teaching Chinese as a foreign language. Since my first year, I have been part of the university's volunteer Chinese tutoring team and have provided one-on-one Chinese lessons to students from ten different countries, building up rich cross-cultural communication experience. I am outgoing and a good listener; in team projects I usually take on a coordination role.
  I have always believed that language is the best bridge between people — and that is why I chose this field. In the future, I hope to contribute to the global promotion of the Chinese language, and I am eager to learn from everyone here. My personal motto is: "Never tire of learning; never tire of teaching."
  I look forward to growing together with you all. Please take care of me!
